How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Hey there mud fam 👋 Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days in the US and 10-15 business days in Canada. DHL handles the shipment and hands it over to USPS for final delivery. Weather and other delays can occasionally affect timing.
